title: For each non-deleted security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to
question: For each non-deleted security group and rule protocol where the maximum “to” port across its rules is greater than 1000, list the security group name, the protocol, that maximum “to” port, and (for tcp rules) the range and variance of the “from” port values for the same security group. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH MaxToPortByGroupProtocol AS (
  SELECT sg.name AS security_group_name,
         sgr.protocol,
         MAX(sgr.to_port) AS max_to_port
  FROM security_groups sg
  JOIN security_group_rules sgr ON sg.id = sgr.parent_group_id
  WHERE sg.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY sg.name, sgr.protocol
  HAVING MAX(sgr.to_port) > 1000
),
TcpFromPortStatsByGroup AS (
  SELECT sg.name AS security_group_name,
         MAX(sgr.from_port) - MIN(sgr.from_port) AS from_port_range,
         VARIANCE(sgr.from_port) AS from_port_variance
  FROM security_groups sg
  JOIN security_group_rules sgr ON sg.id = sgr.parent_group_id
  WHERE sgr.protocol = 'tcp'
  GROUP BY sg.name
)
SELECT mtp.security_group_name,
       mtp.protocol,
       mtp.max_to_port,
       CASE WHEN mtp.protocol = 'tcp' THEN tfs.from_port_range ELSE NULL END AS from_port_range,
       CASE WHEN mtp.protocol = 'tcp' THEN tfs.from_port_variance ELSE NULL END AS from_port_variance
FROM MaxToPortByGroupProtocol mtp
LEFT JOIN TcpFromPortStatsByGroup tfs ON mtp.security_group_name = tfs.security_group_name
ORDER BY mtp.security_group_name, mtp.protocol;

SELECT sg.name,
       r.protocol,
       MAX(r.to_port) AS max_to_port,
       CASE WHEN r.protocol = 'tcp' THEN MAX(r.from_port) - MIN(r.from_port) END AS from_port_range,
       CASE WHEN r.protocol = 'tcp' THEN VAR_POP(r.from_port) END AS from_port_variance
FROM security_groups sg
JOIN security_group_rules r ON r.group_id = sg.id
WHERE sg.deleted = 0
  AND r.deleted = 0
GROUP BY sg.name, r.protocol
HAVING MAX(r.to_port) > 1000
ORDER BY sg.name, r.protocol;

  SELECT sg.id AS sg_id, sg.name AS security_group_name, sgr.protocol, MAX(sgr.to_port) AS max_to_port
  FROM security_groups sg
  JOIN security_group_rules sgr ON sg.id = sgr.group_id
  WHERE sg.deleted = 0 AND sgr.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY sg.id, sg.name, sgr.protocol
  HAVING MAX(sgr.to_port) > 1000
),

  SELECT sg.id AS sg_id,
    MAX(sgr.from_port) - MIN(sgr.from_port) AS from_port_range,
    VARIANCE(sgr.from_port) AS from_port_variance
  FROM security_groups sg
  JOIN security_group_rules sgr ON sg.id = sgr.group_id
  WHERE sg.deleted = 0 AND sgr.deleted = 0 AND sgr.protocol = 'tcp'
  GROUP BY sg.id
)
SELECT gps.security_group_name, gps.protocol, gps.max_to_port,

FROM GroupProtocolStats gps
LEFT JOIN TcpFromPortStats tfps ON gps.sg_id = tfps.sg_id
ORDER BY gps.security_group_name, gps.protocol
